responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s generic path-segment unwrapping helpers used to treat several AST segment wrapper types uniformly. This header owns the unwrap_type_segment template and macro that peel references, const qualifiers, and std::unique_ptr wrappers down to a SimplePathSegment or PathIdentSegment view via get_ident_segment(), along with overloaded/node-pointer-friendly APIs to fetch a segment NodeId or optional lang item, making it a reusable normalization layer for code that operates on type, simple, and expression path segments without duplicating per-class access logic.
same_name_distinction: Defines the reusable generic unwrapping interface for path segments: the unwrap_type_segment template/macro machinery plus declarations and inline unique_ptr adapters for segment NodeId/lang-item queries. Unlike rust-unwrap-segment.cc, it is the header-level normalization API and type-generic wrapper layer, not the file with the per-segment overload implementations.
